s: Partition by the business key, order by something that decides which copy wins (here nothing differs, so any order works; with a LoadedAt column you'd keep the latest).
Count before and after, and record the difference.

code.title: One row per (OrderID, LineNo)
src: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OrderID, LineNo ORDER BY OrderID) AS rn
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_lines)            AS RowsIn,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_lines) - COUNT(*)  AS Removed

sql-window-0.note: If the copies could differ, decide the rule with the data owner (latest load wins? highest status?) and put that in the ORDER BY. An arbitrary ORDER BY makes the result change between runs.

s: Build one clean line-level CTE with the USD value and the order month.
Aggregate by product, rank with RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Gross DESC), keep rank ≤ 3.
Aggregate by month and add SUM(Gross) OVER (ORDER BY Month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING).

code.title: Top three products, Q1 2026
src: WITH lines AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM order_lines),
SELECT l.ProductKey, SUBSTRING(CAST(o.OrderDate AS VARCHAR(10)), 1, 7) AS Month,
ROUND(ROUND(l.Qty * l.UnitPrice * (100 - l.DiscountPct) / 100.0, 2) * COALESCE(fx.USDPerUnit, 1), 2) AS GrossUSD
JOIN orders AS o ON o.OrderID = l.OrderID
LEFT JOIN fx_rates AS fx ON fx.Month = SUBSTRING(CAST(o.OrderDate AS VARCHAR(10)), 1, 7) AND fx.Currency = o.Currency
RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(q1.GrossUSD) DESC) AS Rnk
FROM q1 JOIN products AS p ON p.ProductKey = q1.ProductKey
SELECT Rnk, ProductName, GrossUSD FROM by_product WHERE Rnk <= 3 ORDER BY Rnk;

code.title: Running total by month
src: WITH lines AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM order_lines),
SELECT SUBSTRING(CAST(o.OrderDate AS VARCHAR(10)), 1, 7) AS Month,
ROUND(ROUND(l.Qty * l.UnitPrice * (100 - l.DiscountPct) / 100.0, 2) * COALESCE(fx.USDPerUnit, 1), 2) AS GrossUSD
JOIN orders AS o ON o.OrderID = l.OrderID
LEFT JOIN fx_rates AS fx ON fx.Month = SUBSTRING(CAST(o.OrderDate AS VARCHAR(10)), 1, 7) AND fx.Currency = o.Currency
monthly AS (SELECT Month, SUM(GrossUSD) AS GrossUSD FROM q1 GROUP BY Month)
ROUND(SUM(GrossUSD) OVER (ORDER BY Month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS RunningUSD

s: Aggregate gross by customer, then compute each customer's share of the total with SUM() OVER ().
Rank customers and sum the shares of the top 10.
Interpret: one wholesale account at this share, combined with Sprint 01's finding that it stopped ordering, is a revenue risk to raise, not a curiosity.

code.title: Share of the largest customer
src: WITH lines AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM order_lines),
ROUND(ROUND(l.Qty * l.UnitPrice * (100 - l.DiscountPct) / 100.0, 2) * COALESCE(fx.USDPerUnit, 1), 2) AS GrossUSD
JOIN orders AS o ON o.OrderID = l.OrderID
LEFT JOIN fx_rates AS fx ON fx.Month = SUBSTRING(CAST(o.OrderDate AS VARCHAR(10)), 1, 7) AND fx.Currency = o.Currency
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(GrossUSD) DESC) AS rn
SELECT c.CustomerName, ROUND(b.GrossUSD, 2) AS GrossUSD, ROUND(b.Share * 100, 1) AS SharePct
FROM by_customer AS b JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = b.CustomerID
